name: [DevOps & DB] W08 — PostgreSQL Gece Bütünlük & Veri Snapshot'ı

parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'leads_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM "Lead"),
  'posts_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM "Post"),
  'categories_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM "Category"),
  'users_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM "User"),
  'references_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM "Reference"),
  'audit_logs_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM "AuditLog"),
  'db_size', (SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))),
  'timestamp', NOW()
) as snapshot_meta;

additionalFields.queryParams: ={{ [ 'audit_snap_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9), JSON.stringify({ leads: $json.leadsCount, posts: $json.postsCount, dbSize: $json.dbSize, isOk: $json.isDataIntegrityOk }) ] }}
